description: Search products Jockey Delivery can bring from San Antonio stores. Read-only. Returns products (title, brand, price, image, availability, product url) and the store offer for each. To buy, use create_checkout (then confirm_checkout) once the shopper has chosen the item and given a delivery address; the product url is the fallback.

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "leather boots".

zip.description: Shopper's 5-digit ZIP; the result says whether it is served.

name: search_catalog
title: Search San Antonio store shelves
